thread:
noah: opened PR with migration steps + SDK example. docs CI failing: linkcheck, vale and mdspell. can someone triage quickly?

ci-bot: Running checks for PR #3199: linkcheck, vale, mdspell, markdownlint, preview build.

sara: linkcheck shows an internal anchor 404: `#vpc-quickstart` referenced from getting-started.md.

noah: i changed the heading to `## VPC quick start` (note the space/casing). maybe the generator made a different anchor.

vik: hugo-style anchors tend to lowercase and replace spaces with hyphens but also strip punctuation. try `#vpc-quick-start` or use an explicit HTML anchor.

sara: i'll patch the cross-doc link to `#vpc-quick-start` and push a tiny commit.

ci-bot: mdspell detected `enviroment` in examples/sdk-usage.md -> suggestion: `environment`.

noah: thanks, fixing typo in the snippet now.

ci-bot: vale flagged a tone rule in migration.md: avoid weak phrasing like \"We advise that you...\" (rule DOC-ACTIVE).

vik: replace with an active sentence: `Enable KMS-backed keys for private deployments.` short and clear.

noah: updated wording and fixed the typo; pushed two small commits.

ci-bot: Re-running checks after commits...

ci-bot: linkcheck: one remaining issue - anchor mismatch `#onprem-install` referenced from index.md.

sara: i believe that header is now `On-prem installation` which yields `on-prem-installation` — i'll add a short HTML anchor alias under the header so older links keep working. pushing fix.

ci-bot: markdownlint: wrap long line in migration.md example (MD013).

vik: i'll split the long command into multiple lines inside a fenced block. small change pushed.

ci-bot: All checks passed. Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-3199.docs.redwood.ai/ - please sanity check anchors and the SDK snippet render.

sara: preview looks good. anchors resolve, snippet syntax highlighting fine. one tiny nit: code block line numbers overflow on mobile but not blocking.

noah: timing check: we'd like this merged before docs cut at 18:00 UTC. can one of you approve?

vik: approving now. :+1:

sara: approved.

noah: merging in the release window. /merge

ops-bot: Merge queued. Starting post-merge preview deploy.

ops-bot: Preview live at https://deploy-preview-3199.docs.redwood.ai/ - sanity pass requested.

noah: verified anchors and snippets on the preview. all clear.

vik: follow-up: suggest adding an anchor normalization check in the linkcheck job that mirrors the static site generator rules. i can draft a tiny script and open an issue for ci.

sara: yes please. opens the PR surface to more flakiness otherwise.

vik: filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/548 with a proposed Python script and test cases. tagging eng-infra/ci.

noah: thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:
